tools.name: ListIndexTool
tools.description: This tool gets index information from the OpenSearch cluster. It takes 2 optional arguments named `indices` which is a comma-delimited list of one or more indices to get information from (default is an empty list meaning all indices), and `local` which means whether to return information from the local node only instead of the cluster manager node (default is false). The tool returns the indices information, including `health`, `status`, `index`, `uuid`, `pri`, `rep`, `docs.count`, `docs.deleted`, `store.size`, `pri.store. size `, `pri.store.size`, `pri.store`.

indices.description: OpenSearch index name list, separated by comma. for example: ["index1", "index2"], use empty array [] to list all indices in the cluster

tools.name: SearchIndexTool
tools.description: Search an OpenSearch index by name with an OpenSearch DSL `query`. Supports standard DSL and vector k-NN queries. `query` may be provided as a JSON object (preferred) or as a JSON-encoded string for backward compatibility. Use an index with a vector field and k-NN-capable mapping for vector searches.

oneOf.description: OpenSearch DSL query object. For vector (k-NN) searches, provide a k-NN query object against an index with a vector field.
